text:
In the clenched hand of a dead man,
+
+in the memory of a madman,
+
+in the sorrow of a child,
+
+in the hand reaching for the glass,
+
+in the unreachable glass,
+
+in the thirst as ever.

translation.title: In the Clenched Hand of a Dead Man…
translation.editorial_note: The repeated in carries each enclosure toward the unreachable vessel; sed de siempre becomes thirst as ever, both perpetual and intimately familiar.
